title: Centenarians per 100,000 residents, by state

source.name: Social Security Administration centenarian data, analyzed by state
source.publisher: Social Security Administration (via Northwell Health / Stacker analysis)

notes: 2022 SSA data: Hawaii has the highest share of centenarians in its population (0.24%), followed by Washington DC (0.20%) and Connecticut (0.19%); nationally, centenarians are about 0.03% of the US population (Pew Research, 2024, citing Census Bureau data). Percentages converted here to a per-100,000-residents rate (percent x 1,000) for on-screen readability: 0.24% = 240 per 100,000, etc.
